svg.text: OverKill Smart IR Hub — Connection Diagram
Bare ESP-12F module variant • default GPIOs match firmware; D1 mini needs a UART/CS check
Net flags with the same name and colour are connected.
Logic is 3.3 V. Only the IR LED array uses 5 V. All grounds are common.
3.3 V rail powers ESP-12F, flash, IR receiver, DS18B20 and status LED.
6 branches, 2 LEDs in series per branch, switched by the AO3400 on the low side.
GPIO4 → 100 Ω → gate; the 10 kΩ pulldown keeps the MOSFET off during reset/boot.
Verify branch current against the exact LED datasheet before use.
pins 9–14 = module's internal flash — leave unconnected
GPIO0 low at power-up = serial flash mode (fit JP). Normal run: JP open.
GPIO0 = HIGH, GPIO2 = HIGH, GPIO15 = LOW are required at boot.
FLASH_CS pull-up is recommended: keeps the flash deselected during boot.
Check OUT/VCC/GND silkscreen on your module.
Adapter RX ← TX (GPIO1). Adapter TX → RX (GPIO3, shared with FLASH_CS).
3.3 V adapter only. Hold GPIO0 low (jumper) while powering up to flash.
10 kΩ pull-up; JP → GND to flash
1. USB-C breakout: VBUS = 5 V, GND = common; D+/D− unused.
2. Boot straps: GPIO0 HIGH, GPIO2 HIGH, GPIO15 LOW at power-up.
3. Flash CS = GPIO3 (PIN_FLASH_CS in firmware). It is also UART0 RX,
D1 mini USB-UART TX also drives GPIO3; isolate it or change CS.
4. Pins 9–14 are the ESP-12F's own flash — never connect them.
5. No physical Learn button: learn commands from the Web UI.
6. IR TX, IR RX, status LED and DS18B20 pins are defaults. The Web UI
can remap them, but only to GPIO 1, 2, 4, 5 or 16 (RX: not 16).
7. After first serial flash, disconnect adapter TX; update via OTA
(port 8080, /update, or the Web UI Firmware Upgrade page).
8. Recovery AP: Overkill-XXXXXX at 192.168.4.1 when Wi-Fi is unset.
9. Resistor values are those of the original build; verify IR LED
branch current against the exact LED datasheet before use.
